no-restricted-globals.name: setTimeout
no-restricted-globals.message: Do not call raw setTimeout in components or apps; use createDelay() or createTimeout() from @hewel/zgui so timers cancel when owners dispose.

no-restricted-globals.name: setInterval
no-restricted-globals.message: Do not call raw setInterval in components or apps; use createInterval() or createDelay() from @hewel/zgui instead of unguarded polling.

no-restricted-globals.name: requestAnimationFrame
no-restricted-globals.message: Do not call raw requestAnimationFrame in components or apps; use createSpring() for motion.

no-restricted-globals.name: cancelAnimationFrame
no-restricted-globals.message: Do not manage raw animation frame handles in components or apps; createSpring() owns its frames.
